notes.content:
[h1]🧙‍♂️ Early Access Patch Notes 0.5.198[/h1] 

Dear Wizards,

[b]It's time for the first content update of the Early Access[/b]. New final boss is waiting for you on Nightmare and Hell difficulty levels. We have also improved visuals of spells!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069472/9b732cadc7f0f721a96347d5d8af8a9caeee6c40.gif"][/img]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][Bosses][/b] Added a new final boss on the Nightmare (third) difficulty level.
[*] [b][Spells][/b] Added 3 new spells.
[*] [b][Camera / Visibility][/b] Added new camera mode "Player always in the Center" which is a new default camera mode. Thanks to setting this in the accessibility settings, wizard will always be in the center of camera and thus he will be way easier to notice. Your current settings have not been changed to avoid confusion after loading the patch. [b]We strongly recommend to test it for yourself![/b]
[*] [b][Spells Merging][/b] After failing to merge spells, you now gain extra 5% success chance for each lost spell until your next successful merge. After successfully merging spells, the extra chance is reset.
[*] [b][QOL][/b] Added short time slow effect after getting hit to make it more clear.
[/list]

[h2]🔄 Changed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][Spells][/b] Now all spells are pixelated so they both look better and have a better performance!
[*] [b][Rooms][/b] Reduced number of enemies spawning in small closed rooms. There should be now up to 4 enemies spawning in them at once. Before it was possible to spawn up to 7 enemies which was ridiculous and unfair in some locations.
[*] [b][Enemies][/b] Reduced Necromancer's life steal by 33%
[*] [b][Meta Progression][/b] Reworked Lich Power upgrade. Instead of regenerating 1 HP every [10 / 9 / ... / 3] seconds, it now regenerates 1 HP every [3 / 3 / 2 / 2 / 1 / 1] seconds, but can regenerate only up to [20% / 22% / 24% / 26% / 28% / 30%] instead of up to 100%. So it will regenerate HP faster, but with lower % max health limit.
[*] [b][QOL][/b] Renamed "Exit" to "Save & Exit" in the pause menu so all of you will know that the game automatically saves when you exit during a run.
[/list]

[h2]⚙️ Fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][Enemies][/b] Fixed a bug where Goblin Assassin and Void Worm could get permanently stuck in their reappear animations which was making them forever immortal.
[/list]

Improving their performance however will not be as easy since it will require me to completely rework how their work and use more advanced Unity's system so it will take me some time to develop. notes.title: The First Day of EA Release: A Developer's Note-Devlog
notes.content:
Dear Wizards,

As a main developer of An Amazing Wizard, from the bottom of my heart, I would like to thank every single one of you who have played the game and enjoy it despite its flaws. [b]There are over 1000 of you already and it makes me insanely happy! [/b]

[h3]We need your feedback[/h3]
We are here to listen to all your feedback and feel free to share anything you like or don't like in Steam Discussions, Review or in our official Discord. I try to respond as quickly as possible and I'm making notes about what should be fixed ASAP.

[b]Expect to see the first bug fixing / QOL patch later today! [/b]
This is just the beggining of our Early Access journey and we want to make the game as good as possible for you all.

[h3]How is that possible?[/h3]
For everyone interested, I would like you to know that this game is a result of me working in my spare time after daily job for over 6 years and over 9000 hours spent on it. That being said, we will do everything we can to improve the gaming experience.

[h3]Visual Issue[/h3]
Some of you have mentioned visibility problems or little cohesion between different biomes or enemies. The difference in quality between them is result of something very simple. All game art was made by just 1 pixel artist who didn't had as much experience 4 years ago, when he started making art for this game, as he has now. That's why some parts of the game look way better visually than others. We will be doing some improvements to it later during Early Access.

P.S. I love seeing the game being compared to Dead Cells or Noita and watching positive reaction from streamers. Thank you everyone who help the game being noticed by as many people as possible.

notes.title: Prologue Spell Merge Master Tips
notes.content:
Hello!
First of all, thank you for playing An Amazing Wizard. This has been our passion project for nearly 5 years, and we’re thrilled to have you onboard.

[h3]🔻🔻🔻We need your help!🔻🔻🔻[/h3]

[b][url=https://forms.gle/iNTP6SpNtNKGJyRNA]Join us for a feedback interview about An Amazing Wizard and help shape its future![/url][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2920980/An_Amazing_Wizard_Prologue/
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2][b]Top Merge Combos[/b][/h2]
While you’re free to experiment with Spell Merging, we’ve noticed some combinations can feel unintuitive. Here are a few ideas to help beginners get started:

[b]Crowd Control:[/b]
Merge [Gravity Zone] into a projectile spell like [Fireball]. Then, combine this with an AoE or Wall-type spell to maximize damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/c25de433e15b294ebde1e163ffb219f17172ada6.gif[/img]

[b]Spell Rain:[/b]
Sacrifice AoE like [Fire Rain] into Projectile like [Cosmic Ice]. Sacrifice the combo into AoE like [Fire Rain] again. Sacrifice the combo into Projectile like [Cosmic Ice] again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/4e9f5baae315ca291d0905b0cd9cc5af24487cd5.gif[/img]

[b]Empowered Summons:[/b]
Merge offensive spells like [Ice Wave] or [Electric Blade] into a summon, allowing the summon to cast them when it attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/ed32f4e9b9738b0425ee3db4d96774ef23a0baf2.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Advanced Tips[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] You can summon the Spellweaver at any time by [right-clicking] the crystal he gave you from your inventory.
[*] Merging the same spell will strengthen it without taking up additional Merge Slots (dots).
[*] Enchantments will occupy your Merge Slots.
[*] More powerful spells (indicated by a grade of +/- number) consume more mana, meaning merged spells will also cost more. But no change in the cooldowns,
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/bf336934600207f23940841f933e7a040d485fe8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Prologue is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for taking the time to play the game! We would really appreciate it if you could leave a review[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2920980/An_Amazing_Wizard_Prologue/
Leaving review will:

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/0862ce4c01ffcb782665a74811dc38b0c3b2f821.png[/img]
[h1]What is An Amazing Wizard?[/h1]
For us, it is a passion project we worked on for four years in our free time after daily jobs.
For you, it is a side-scroller where you hit very different monsters by casting spells in their faces : )

To be more precise, [b]An Amazing Wizard is a fast-paced metroidvania-like 2D hand-drawn pixel art game where you Create your own Spells to fight enemies[/b]. in this FREE Prologue demo you could:
[list]
[*] Fight using 60 Spells and a dozen melee weapons
[*] Enchant with Spells and Weapons 100 special effect
[*] Collect 120 Artifacts
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/05b62b74e9897c9d9079267b5d2561d94ea3d541.gif[/img]
[list][*] Level up to choose from 100 upgrades in different rarities
[*] Merge spells up to 4 times to set an order of effects[/list]
[h1]What is Spell Merging? How does it work?[/h1]
By [b]MERGING [/b]spells, you set rules for the trigger and order. It is a bit like in Bio Prototype or Magicraft, but with the catch:
[h3][b]Order:[/b] Spells activate simultaneously with the 1st spell, One after another, or in groups[/h3]

[h3]Here is an example of SIMULTANEOUS + GROUP Merge：[/h3]
[b]BEFORE[/b]
[list]
[*] Icicle shoots few projectiles in rapid progression
[*] Fireball is strong and ignites enemies
[*] Friendly Fire orbits around you[/list]
[b]MERGE[/b]
[olist]
[*] Friendly Fire into Fireball >> Friendly Fire orbits around Fireball
[*] Merged spell into Icicle >> Fireball with Friendly Fire shoots together with Icicle projectile
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/cf0b474c6ed60b305ffada07fb81acc1840bdfc2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Trigger:[/b] Spells are activated according to the Main/Sacrifice spell type: on hit, on cast, during the active phase[/h3]
[h3]Tornado-type Spells vs other types:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Zone-type spells will cast several Tornados in different directions
[*] Bomb-type will cast a few Tornados on hit / destruction
[*] Projectile-type will cast Tornados upon launch
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984544/af5be5f380800ca2725900b85f2ca1e6b4379503.gif[/img]
[h1]What is the size of the content in Prologue?[/h1]
[list][*] Play as wizards of 5 elements
[*] Experience the Ancient Desert and The Hell with 2 difficulties
[*] Fight mobs, mini-bosses, and epic world lords
[*] A couple of dozen unique enemies stand before you and victory
[/list]

If you REALLY like the Free Prologue, help us and wishlist the Full Game:

See you in less than 1 week in the Prologue!

In the last 2 weeks we were mainly working on 🚨 [b]BIG balance changes to all spells[/b] 🚨, new enemies, QOL changes and bug fixes.

There was a big problem before where the Basic Spell felt way too powerful whereas Special Spells felt like they costed too much mana or had too high cooldown. These changes try to do something about this problem. We want to move power from Basic Spell to Special Spells. We want you to use more fun Special Spells than spamming the Basic Spell and using Special Spells occasionally.

notes.title: 🧙 Prologue Release Announcement ✨
notes.content:
[i]Hello! I'm Jakub, a Java developer from Poland. Together with the Venezuelan artist Ivan, we are creating [b]An Amazing Wizard[/b]. This is the first game for both of us, and we would greatly appreciate your support by adding [b]An Amazing Wizard[/b] to your Wishlist. Thank you![/i]

[h3]PROLOGUE WILL BE RELEASED IN SEPTEMBER![/h3]
In the meantime, [b][url=https://www.alienwarearena.com/ucf/Giveaway]Alienware [/url][/b]will be hosting a [b]free preview[/b] playtest on [b]August 2nd[/b]. Visit their website to gain early access. Just before the release, we will also open a playtest for everyone to try out the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2920980/An_Amazing_Wizard_Prologue/

[h3]What is An Amazing Wizard?[/h3]
[b]An Amazing Wizard[/b] is a [b]2D fast-paced metroidvania-inspired spell-slinging combat RPG[/b] game with [b]detailed pixel art[/b]. You play as a wizard from legend, wielding the magic of [b]7 elements[/b] cast by mysterious hands. [b]Enchant [/b]your [b]spells and melee weapons[/b], defeat enemies to [b]level up[/b] and choose from [b]250 perks[/b]. [b]Discover [/b]and equip [b]250 artifacts[/b], and [b]merge 100 unique spells[/b] in any desired order. Collect your [b]lost memories[/b] and uncover the [b]hidden truth[/b] about this world.

[h3]New to the Free Prologue![/h3]
We've added [b]Spell Merge[/b]. You can now take spells to the Spellweaver and [b]merge[/b] them [b]up to 5 times[/b]. Here's an example:

Lesser Fireball: A magic ball that sets the enemy on fire:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069472/3d504ec9673d8cbddf2f2f121a7924fd023943c7.gif[/img]

✨MERGE TIME!✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069472/1d14fca3d61c054fa08e344003c5c5f045dd62e2.png[/img]

Cast Gravity Zone that catches the enemy in place upon Fireball impact:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069472/ae25cc3168f2252a6e24c925ca856e498a9add18.gif[/img]

Explore the new Ancient Desert world, a brand-new map with new enemies like thunder spirits that duplicate near you and mummies that strike from afar with extending bandages. 

We've also revamped the UI for the Bestiary to make hunting more intuitive. And there are 2 new bosses and new elites that were not present in the previous demo.

notes.title: KICKSTARTER - MARCH 8th!
notes.content:
[url=https://bit.ly/AAW-KS][h1]Kickstarter Preview[/h1][/url]

The idea to run a Kickstarter campaign has been with me for a long time. I know we can finish the game, but how long it will take on my means? My disposable income is not enough to make the game I want to create.

Partially, the art was provided by the publisher, Erabit. But I do not want to dive into "funding" and share rights for our game, so we had a mostly marketing deal. Only in case something unfortunate happens to me or Ivan, Erabit would follow our designs to complete the game.

[h1]Wants vs. Needs[/h1]
[b]According to the current plan, before the Early Access this year we need to do the following:[/b]
[list]
[*] 26 mobs, 3 minibosses, 2 bosses in all 5 biomes
[*] Final boss
[*] Void Level (final one) tiles & decorations
[*] Languages: English, Chinese (Simpl. & Trad.), Polish, Spanish, Italian
[*] Basic Dialogues
[/list]

[b]What we would love to have:[/b]
[list]
[*] 20+ more enemies, including 4 extra minibosses on higher difficulty levels
[*] At least 2 more final bosses and more normal bosses
[*] Secret Bosses
[*] 10 more Spells & 20+ more Weapons
[*] More skins for MC (currently it is one in different colors)
[*] More animations for MC (special animations when you are on low health, having magic hands always visible and animated better, etc)
[*] Showing picked up Artifacts on MC
[*] Manga-like cutscenes
[*] Lots of secrets
[*] Romance/Hidden Story
[*] More NPC dialogues (generated based on your progress like in Hades 🤩)
[*] More Languages Supported
[*] Console porting
[*] Commission soundtracks
[*] More Trap Levels
[*] More Interactable Objects inside levels
[/list]

[b]€10,000 will be enough to make the game x2 better![/b]

Another reason is, I want more people to leave a handprint in the game. After the Kickstarter, I will focus on creating the content that will be voted the most. This way it will not just be my game, but a journey shared with more people.

[b]Disclaimer[/b]
[i]95% of the Kickstarter revenue will go to the content creation, and 5% will be Kickstarter fees. The publisher will not receive anything from this campaign.[/i]

-Gobo

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.41 DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.41 DEMO[/h1]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]
[Items] It's now possible to pick up spell or magic weapon directly to the inventory after holding the button for 0,75 seconds.
[Enemies] Added small random delay before enemies jump while you are in air to make them feel less robotic.
[Debuffs] Added system to prevent enemies to get permanently slowed, frozen, feared, charmed, confused, petrified or snared. Now when you apply one of these debuffs on enemies you need to wait 2.25x of debuff's time to be able to apply it again. For example after applying fear debuff lasting 1 second you will need to wait for 1,25 seconds after the effect ends to be able to apply fear debuff on the same enemy again. It had to be added because with certain spells you could remove all challenge (and fun) by permanently stunning all enemies. You can still do permanent stunning, but there is some skill and spell combo required to do so now. It also encourage to use spells of few different elements at the same time rather than sticking to a single element only.

[h2]🔄 Changed:[/h2]
[Melee Spells] Buffed range of Wind Cutting Fist, Tesla Blast and Zombie Blast spells.
[Spells] Buffed Cupid's Arrow charm duration 3.25 => 6.5 seconds
[Enemies] Normal enemies chance to become elites now scales by how far they are spawned from the level start point by up to 5.75 multiplier. Lowered base chance for enemies to become elite 3% => 2.25%.
[Enemies] Miniboss and boss enemies now always have 3 => 5% chance to become elites.

[h2]⚙️ Fixed:[/h2]
[b][Spells] All Spells now rotate towards aimed position.[/b]
[Laser Beam] Laser Beam now rotates towards aimed position.
[Summons] Fixed a bug where summons sometimes were immortal if they timed their teleport with the time they were supposed to be killed.
[Enemies] Fixed a bug where charmed enemies were standing still doing nothing.
[Enemies] Fixed a bug where charmed enemies sometimes attacked themselves with projectiles.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.34 DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.34 DEMO[/h1]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]
[b][UI] Added Inventory where you are able to swap your spells and weapons and see all your current stats and selected perks.[/b]
[b][Spells] All projectile spells (including Basic Spell) now fire exactly at the aimed position.[/b]
[b][Magic Weapons] All Magic Weapons now rotate towards the aimed position.[/b]

[h2]🔄 Changed:[/h2]
[b][Basic Spell] Reduced base Basic Spell damage to 10 => 5.5, increased it's attack speed to 1.75 => 2.3 and reduced knockback to 7.25 => 3.8[/b]
[Spells] Buffed Arcane Bomb (Cooldown reduced 7.5 => 5.5 seconds and increased it's max damage to 29 => 43).
[Key Bindings] Changed default secondary dash key to left control.

[h2]⚙️ Fixed:[/h2]
[Spells UI] It's now possible to read Basic Spell description when hovering over it's icon in the Main Game UI.
[Settings UI] Now player needs to click on the menu buttons in the Settings in order to change them instead of it auto changing when hovering.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.33 DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.33 DEMO[/h1]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]
[Enchantments] Now exact enchantments values are displayed while selecting new enchantment to add instead of X.
[Minimap] It's now possible to drag the minimap with mouse left button and scroll.
[Minimap] Now it's possible to click the destination with mouse when using Teleporting Altars (the ones that look like a tree).
[Magic Weapons] Added showing + / - to all base values when comparing 2 Magic Weapons.

[h2]🔄 Changed:[/h2]
[Shop] Shop prices colors were changed. Default price is now white and discounted price is green.
[Sacrifice Altar] Sacrifice Altars now will drop better loot more often (5% chance for Pickup items, 20% for Normal items, 65% for Rare Items and 10% for Very Rare items).
[Sacrifice Altar] Increased base health cost of Sacrifice Altars to 90.

[h2]⚙️ Fixed:[/h2]
[Crosshair] Now it's possible to move the fake controller crosshair using mouse (it shows when you have any controller plugged in).
[Magic Weapons] Fixed a bug where you could have all owned Magic Weapons passive powers if you exit and then continue the run.
[Characters] All characters will now properly teleport after falling to the last platform they were standing on rather on the last platform they have touched (no more enemies stucking inside walls after falling).
[Spells] Fixed a bug where when you had 2 same projectile spells, their enchantments were working together. For example if you had 2 Lesser Fireballs and only one of them had piercing power then both of these fireballs had the piercing enchantment applied instead of only the correctly enchanted spell.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.32 DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.32 DEMO[/h1]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]
[b][UI] It's now possible to interact with menu elements using the mouse.[/b]
[Save Slots] Run now automatically launch after selecting a save slot.
[Minimap] Added option to zoom in and out the minimap with mouse scroll.
[Minimap] Added M key as another default key for enabling the minimap.

[Crosshair] Crosshair is now disabled by default on controllers and enabled by default when using mouse + keyboard. This is based on whether you have a controller plugged in or not.
[Basic Spell] Basic Spell is no longer able to go through walls for 0,05 seconds after casting.
[Spawning Enemies] Slightly increased chance for double spawning enemies.
[Enemies] Slightly buffed enemies health.
[Destroyable Elements] Lowered base chance to drop a weapon from destroyable elements (7,3% => 5,5%)
[Destroyable Elements] Increased base chance to drop pickup items(health potions, keys, etc) from destroyable elements (2,1% => 2,6%)
[Magic Weapons] Now cooldown text is displayed instead of "attack speed" in Magic Weapons description to avoid confusion.

[h2]⚙️ Fixed:[/h2]
[b][UI] Fixed interacting with all UI elements when using mouse.[/b]
[UI] Mouse scroll is now working properly in all UI elements.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.31 DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.31 DEMO[/h1]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]

[Tutorial] Added Italian translation for the tutorial.

[UI] Fixed a bug where rarely after closing a menu it was possible to hear select noise while walking.
[Pause Menu] Fixed a bug where no icon was shown while hovering over changed spells.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.30 DEMO
notes.content:

[Astral World] Added Target Dummy to the Astral World.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.29 DEMO
notes.content:

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.28 DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.28 DEMO[/h1]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]
[b][Astral World] Added fast upgrade function when unlocking things in the Astral World (the longer you hold the button, the faster it upgrades).
[Trap Rooms] Spikes and Totems are now highlighted in Trap Rooms.[/b]

[Crafter NPCs] Weaponsmith, Spellcrafter and Artifact Smelter now properly have empty item description when no item is selected.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.27 DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.27 DEMO[/h1]

[h2]✅ Added:[/h2]
[b][Magic Weapons] Added 5 new unlockable Magic Weapons. Unlocking Weaponsmith finally doesn't feel like a scam.[/b]
[b][Astral World] Currencies (Crystals and Elemental Orbs) are no longer removed when exiting the Astral World. Finally no need to visit every altar after each run, yay.[/b]
[b][Projectiles] Piercing player's projectiles now can deal damage many times to the same enemy.[/b]
[Dash] Added "DODGE" text when successfully avoided taking damage while dashing.
[Tooltips] Now Dash tooltip is displayed when entering the Astral World.

[h2]🔄 Changed:[/h2]
[b][Trap Rooms] Removed Trap Rooms with Gravity Zones, because they were too annoying to deal with.[/b]
[b][Chests] Cursed Chest will now always drop one strong(very rare or legendary) and one weak(normal or rare) item.[/b]
[b][Bosses] Nerfed dragons damage.[/b]
[Dash] Dash invulnerability time increased 0.27sec => 0.35sec
[Outlines] Enemies outlines color is now black. It's also disabled by default now.
[Tooltips] Dash tooltip duration has been increased.
[Stomp] Buffed stomp base damage 7.5 => 19 and it's knockback force 12 => 15
[Curses] Increased player's vision with Curse of the Darkness 8 => 9.25
[Curses] Increased Curse of the Short Vision minimap range 18 => 42

[h2]⚙️ Fixed:[/h2]
[Unlocking NPCs] Zombie Blast spell description will no longer be present when you have nothing to unlock in the Weaponsmith, Spellcrafter and Artifact Smelter NPCs.
[Doors / Curse of Eternal Battle] Curse of Eternal Battle no longer causes Challenge Door to constantly open/close (fixed that annoying annoying open door sound).
[Doors] Wooden Door no longer deal damage to the player if you shoot them while standing too close to them.
[Enemies] Enemies will now always properly lose health when falling off clifs (they will no longer prevent you from gaining XP or prevent you from opening some chests/doors).
[Enemies] Fixed a bug where enemies were no taking damage from debuffs when they ran away too far from the player.

notes.title: [Demo Patch Notes] Update 0.3.26 DEMO
notes.content:

[b][Traps / Settings] Added outline to environmental traps. It's added as a toggle in the settings (enabled by default). Traps are now always visible on top of all destroyable elements.

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Update 0.3.25 DEMO
notes.content:
